content.comment_body: How can I create a backup from the [product_name] slave module? I am only able to make backups from the master.
A slave [product_name] module does not contain its own program, only the master does. Therefore, it isn't possible to back up a program from a slave module.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is attempting to back up data from a [product_name] slave module, but is informed that only the master module contains programmable logic. This exchange highlights confusion about the roles of master and slave modules within the system and reveals gaps in user understanding regarding backup procedures.
analysis.user_expectations: The user assumes it is possible to back up programs individually from both master and slave [product_name] modules, not realizing that slave modules do not independently store backup-relevant information.
